mappings.note: This verse contains text about 'rejoicing in youth' and 'following your heart' which is completely absent from the OSMAIN text. The OSMAIN text begins directly with 'Remember your Creator'. This content corresponds to Ecclesiastes 12:1a-2 in standard Bibles, but is missing here.

This verse ('Bannis le chagrin...') continues the theme of youth and vanity not found in OSMAIN. It corresponds to Ecclesiastes 12:2b-3a in standard Bibles, but is missing from the provided OSMAIN text.
Matches OSMAIN v1 perfectly ('Husk din Skaper...'). The translation splits the standard chapter into two verses (v1 and v2 in standard Bibles), but here it aligns with OSMAIN v1.
Matches OSMAIN v2 perfectly ('Før solen og lyset...').
Matches the beginning of OSMAIN v3. The translation cuts off at 'ser obsc' (regardant par les fenêtres... seront obscures), whereas OSMAIN v3 continues to describe them becoming dark.
Matches OSMAIN v4 perfectly ('Når dørene mot gaten lukkes...').

Matches the first half of OSMAIN v5. The translation ends at 'car l'homme s'en va vers sa demeure' (For man goes to his eternal home), but cuts off before the final clause in OSMAIN v5: 'og sørgende' (and mourners).
Matches OSMAIN v6 perfectly ('Før sølvsnoren rykkes løs...').
Matches OSMAIN v7 perfectly ('Støvet vender tilbake til jorden...').
Matches OSMAIN v8 perfectly ('Tomhet og atter tomhet...').
Matches OSMAIN v9 perfectly ('I tillegg til at Forkynneren var vis...').
Matches OSMAIN v10 perfectly ('Forkynneren søkte å finne passende ord...').
Matches OSMAIN v11 perfectly ('De vises ord er som oksepigger...').
Matches OSMAIN v12 perfectly ('Og videre, min sønn, la deg advare...').
Matches OSMAIN v13 perfectly ('Sluttordet, når alt er hørt...').
Matches OSMAIN v14 perfectly ('For Gud skal føre hver gjerning fram...').

extraContent.description: The entire verse is extra content not found in OSMAIN. It contains the exhortation to 'rejoice in your youth' and warnings about vanity before the command to remember the Creator.
The entire verse is extra content not found in OSMAIN. It continues the warning about banishing sorrow and states that youth is vanity.
